edition.cue: Serve the lobster when Madison eats it whole at the restaurant.

s.note: Fresh oysters on ice with lemon and shallot mignonette
s.how: Finely dice 2 shallots and mix with 80ml red wine vinegar and plenty of cracked pepper. Rest 20 minutes. Lay 24 freshly shucked oysters on crushed ice, with lemon wedges and the mignonette in a small bowl with a spoon.

s.note: Beer-battered flathead and chips in paper cones with tartare
s.how: Whisk 150g flour, 50g cornflour and 300ml cold lager to a batter. Cut 600g potatoes into chips and fry twice. Dip 500g flathead strips in batter and fry at 180C for 3 minutes. Serve in paper cones with tartare and lemon.

m.note: Boiled lobster, split and grilled with garlic butter
m.how: Cook 2 raw lobsters, about 800g each, in boiling salted water for 8 minutes per 500g. Split lengthways, crack the claws and brush the flesh with 100g butter melted with 3 garlic cloves. Grill flesh-side up for 2 minutes. Serve with drawn butter and lemon.

w.note: Blue jelly over coconut panna cotta with gummy fish on top
w.how: Bloom 3 gelatine leaves and stir into 400ml warm coconut milk with 60g sugar. Set in four glasses for 2 hours. Steep 10 butterfly pea flowers in 400ml hot water with 60g sugar, add 3 more gelatine leaves, cool and pour over. Set, then add gummy fish.

d.note: Vodka, blue curaçao and lemonade over ice with lemon
d.how: For each drink, fill a tall glass with ice and add 30ml vodka and 20ml blue curaçao. Top with about 150ml lemonade and stir gently. Garnish with a lemon wheel. Makes four, so mix them one at a time.
